metadata.description: Biswajeet Das's portable agent-skills marketplace. Harness-neutral SKILL.md skills for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Codex, and Cursor — installable per-skill or as a bundle.

plugins.name: reviewloop
plugins.description: Drive a PR to all-clear across every reviewer — Greptile, CodeRabbit, Copilot, other bots, and humans. Bots get re-triggered and re-checked in a loop; humans get one pass then hand back.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: Generate a paste-ready daily standup from your GitHub activity — merged, opened, and reviewed PRs across the org, rendered as a Done / Today / Blockers block.

plugins.name: ciloop
plugins.description: Drive a failing CI run back to green — pull the real error from the GitHub Actions logs, reproduce it locally, fix the confident failures, push once, and re-watch until green. The red-CI twin of reviewloop.

plugins.name: everything
plugins.description: Install all of Biswajeet's skills at once (reviewloop + ciloop + standup).
